notes.title: Update 18th April 2025
notes.notes:
General Bug Fixes, Improvements & Redesign of Zoom Functionality.

Including:

Redesigned zoom control system
Bug fixes in achievement activation
Improved in-game update system
New animation in loading screen
Improvements to colour schemes

notes.title: Update 12th April 2025
notes.notes:
Improvements to Pause and Settings Menus, including:

Bug fixes
Redesign of Pause Menu
Improved Custom Input Map when accessed in Settings Menu
You can now access the Pause Menu by pressing Escape in-game

Improved Custom Input Mapping, including:

Left and Right Mouse Buttons can now be used in Player Custom Input Map
Adjustments to Default Input Map
